_comment: The admission rows (card admit1, review fable-logic-review-2026-11-25 P4): ONE home for the floors that decide whether a hero may enter an area or leave town. internal/admit reads this file; the old judges (earlyRouteCheck, questWalkCheck, povertyAreaWhy, kitFloorWhy, leanEntryWhy, denFloor) are providers that read their numbers from here, so a number lives once. Numbers moved unchanged from earlyroutes.json and povertyfarm.json (evidence there: Questy bed 2026-11-25 and 2026-11-26, SME ballpark, U). A floor changes only with the margin model or a seed set, never one death (P10). All rows apply in Normal only and never to a corpse run or the owner's try anyway. Archetype is the class family the caller resolves: melee or caster.
